targets.relevance_reason: AuthorizationHeader.apply (28–46) implements the Bottle plugin wrapper: it checks whether the route accepts self.keyword, obtains the authorization value through the base method, dispatches to the subclass parser, injects the returned mapping into kwargs, and invokes the callback.

HttpBasicAuthentication inherits AuthorizationHeader (14), uses http_basic_credentials as the default keyword (20–22), and parse_authorization_value (28–36) decodes the Basic value into UserPasswordPair and returns {self.keyword: ret}. This is the concrete half of the base-class/plugin contract.
